newsitem.title: USA: Applied Micro says 1st qtr net to be below expectation.
newsitem.headline: Applied Micro says 1st qtr net to be below expectation.

text.p: Applied Microsystems Corp. said Friday it expects revenues and earnings to be below analysts' expectations for its first quarter ending March 31, 1997.

Based on preliminary sales totals, the company expects net revenues for the first quarter to be between $8.5 million and $9.0 million compared with $8.7 million in the prior year's quarter and average street expectations of $11.2 million.
The company said it expects earnings to somewhere around seven cents a share, compared with 10 cents a share in the prior year's quarter and average analysts' expectations of 15 cents a share.

The lower revenue estimates reflect longer than anticipated quarter-ending sales cycles and unfavourable currency exchange rate fluctuations, especially as it relates to a weakening Japanese Yen in relation to the dollar.
"Obviously, we are quite disappointed with these figures," said Robert Deinhammer, president and chief executive officer of Redmond, Wash.-based Applied Microsystems.
